description: Editable EOG forecast and valuation assumptions. Facts and guidance are NOT typed here: a value is either an explicit analyst number (with rationale) or a rule that code resolves from sourced data (guidance file, STEO, history, market snapshots). Edit a number or rule, then rerun Sections 12-16. Percent values are in percent (2.0 = 2%).

valuation.rationale: Valuation on the analysis date. The last filed balance sheet is 2026-09-30. FY2026 is an estimate (nine months reported + fourth-quarter forecast); only the part of Q4 after the valuation date is discounted. Five explicit years per the master spec.

drivers.label: Oil and condensate volume growth
drivers.rationale: No 2027+ volume guidance is in SEC filings. Press reports of the Q3 call cite 'low single-digit' 2027 oil growth; 2% is applied to the Q4 2026 guided rate, which already excludes the Barnett and (mostly) Woodford sales. Not assumed to be organic growth from acquisitions.

drivers.label: NGL volume growth
drivers.rationale: Held equal to oil growth. The Janus processing expansion supports NGL recovery, but no quantified guidance exists.

drivers.label: U.S. natural gas volume growth
drivers.rationale: Held equal to oil growth; associated gas and Utica/Dorado gas are not separately guided.

drivers.label: International (Trinidad and other) gas volume growth
drivers.base: Q4 2026 guided total gas less U.S. gas
drivers.rationale: Trinidad volumes are contract-driven and volatile; held flat. Small share of value.

drivers.label: WTI benchmark price
drivers.rationale: EIA STEO annual average for years it covers. After the STEO horizon an explicit long-term flat nominal deck of $70/Bbl is used: it equals EIA's December 2027 monthly WTI forecast (the STEO exit rate), because the 2027 average still reflects the elevated 2026 prices EIA expects to fade. Edit after_last to change the long-term deck.

drivers.label: Henry Hub benchmark price
drivers.rationale: EIA STEO Henry Hub spot (USD/Mcf), a proxy for the NYMEX settle EOG uses for its differential. After the horizon the last full STEO year's average is held flat (a 12-month average avoids winter/summer seasonality in a single exit month). Set after_last to a number to override.

drivers.label: Oil realized price above (below) WTI
drivers.rationale: FY2026 U.S. guidance midpoint, used for the composite (Trinidad/other oil is under 1% of volume). Full-year guidance avoids quarterly timing.

drivers.label: NGL realization as % of WTI
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint. History (2021-2025) ranged widely, so the guided level is preferred over a historical average.

drivers.label: U.S. gas realized price above (below) Henry Hub
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint (seasonality-neutral). The Brent-linked gas contract starting 2027 and the JKM-linked agreement are not modeled separately; they are potential upside to this differential.

drivers.label: International gas realized price
drivers.rationale: Trinidad FY2026 guided realization applied to all international gas; held flat in nominal terms.

drivers.label: Cash cost and capex inflation
drivers.rationale: Applied to per-Boe cash costs and capex per Boe from 2027. Roughly the Fed's long-run inflation objective; no company guidance.

drivers.label: Lease and well cost
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint (Q4 guidance is seasonally higher), inflated from 2027.

drivers.label: Gathering, processing and transportation cost
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint, inflated from 2027.

drivers.label: General and administrative cost
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint, inflated from 2027. Includes stock compensation, which is treated as a real cost (not added back).

drivers.label: DD&A rate
drivers.rationale: Q4 2026 guided midpoint: the depletion rate has risen through 2026 and Q4 is the latest run-rate. Not inflated (book cost). Affects value only through the tax shield.

drivers.label: Taxes other than income
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint; severance taxes scale with commodity revenue.

drivers.label: Exploration and dry-hole expense
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guidance midpoint held flat. Split between exploration and dry hole using the nine-month 2026 reported mix (dry-hole cost is also inside guided capex, so it is removed from capex to avoid double counting).

drivers.label: Recurring impairments
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guided 'impairment excluding certain impairments'. Charged in EBIT and added back as noncash in UFCF because the related cash (leasehold) is inside capex. Large price-driven impairments are not forecast.

drivers.label: Marketing revenue less marketing costs (net)
drivers.rationale: Forecast on a net basis: gross third-party marketing revenue and its purchase cost are excluded together. Median of the five reported years.

drivers.label: Other revenue, net
drivers.rationale: Median of the five reported years. Derivative gains/losses and asset-disposition gains are not forecast (no hedge book or sales assumed).

drivers.label: Operating tax rate on EBIT
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guided effective rate (21% federal plus state/foreign), consistent with the 2021-2025 effective rates.

drivers.label: Current (cash) share of tax provision
drivers.rationale: Median 2021-2025 current/total provision. The deferred share is added back as a noncash item in the explicit years only; the terminal year is taxed fully in cash.

drivers.label: Capital expenditures per Boe
drivers.rationale: FY2026 guided capex divided by FY2026 guided production, inflated from 2027, so spending scales with volume. A rough maintenance-plus-growth proxy: it does not prove the program sustains the volumes.

drivers.label: Capitalized interest inside capex
drivers.rationale: Removed from capex for unlevered cash flow: it is a financing cost reflected in the cost of debt.

drivers.label: Asset retirement cash settlements
drivers.rationale: Median 2021-2025 ARO liabilities settled (XBRL). This line can include obligations transferred with sold properties, so it is an approximation of cash plugging costs.

drivers.label: Operating NWC (receivables + inventory - payables)
drivers.rationale: Narrow proxy only; tax accounts excluded (taxes are modeled separately). Accounts payable includes some capital payables; with accrual-basis capex this is a timing approximation.

risk_free.rationale: 10-year Treasury par yield on the valuation date.

equity_risk_premium.rationale: Ten-year average of Damodaran's implied ERP (smooths single-year swings); the latest year-end value is shown as a reference.

beta.rationale: Damodaran E&P unlevered beta (cash-corrected) relevered at EOG's market D/E. FMP's regression beta is shown for reference; a single-stock regression beta is noisy.

pre_tax_cost_of_debt.rationale: FY2026 guided net interest plus capitalized interest, divided by average debt (2025 year-end and latest quarter).

tax_rate.rationale: Same operating tax rate as the forecast.

perpetuity_growth.rationale: Below long-run inflation: finite drilling inventory and long-run demand uncertainty. Must be below WACC.

exit_multiple.rationale: EOG's current EV / LTM EBITDA (operating-income basis). Market-implied and partly circular; compare both terminal methods.

equity_bridge.rationale: Debt and cash from the 2026-09-30 balance sheet. Woodford sale proceeds (closed 2026-10-19) are added; dividends declared and unpaid at 2026-09-30 are subtracted. Operating leases are excluded from debt because lease costs are inside operating expenses. Cash flows and buybacks between 2026-10-01 and the valuation date are not captured (approximation).
